title: oxypolis denticulata
intro: Oxypolis denticulata, commonly known as the water dropwort, is a perennial herb native to New Zealand. The health benefits of Oxypilis denticulata include its use as a treatment for various gastrointestinal issues, such as digestive problems and diarrhea, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve pain, making it useful in the treatment of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Oxypilis denticulata include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
